2_Introduction: The device achieves a notably enhanced PCE of 25.241%, corresponding to a JSC of 25.981 mA/cm², a VOC of 1.1815 V, and an FF of 82.2295%.  The perovskite (Cs0.05MA0.1FA0.85PbI3.0) solution was prepared with a concentration of 1.65 mol/L in mixed solvent of DMF and DMSO. The precursor solution was deposited on the substrate and spun cast at 1000 rpm for 5 s, followed by 5500 rpm for 30 s. 150 µL CB was dripped onto the center of film at 15 s before the end of spin-coating. The resulting wet perovskite films were annealed at 110 °C for 15 min.
3_Result_Discussion: The enhanced photovoltaic performance stems from the synergistic interplay between the carefully engineered triple-cation perovskite composition (Cs₀.₀₅MA₀.₁FA₀.₈₅PbI₃) and its precisely controlled crystallization dynamics. The A-site cation mixture, dominated by formamidinium (FA) for an optimal bandgap and stabilized by small amounts of methylammonium (MA) and cesium (Cs) to improve the tolerance factor and suppress phase segregation, lays the foundation for enhanced thermal and structural stability. The crystallization process, initiated from a 1.65 mol/L precursor in a DMF:DMSO co-solvent system, is critically governed by the two-step spin-coating protocol; the initial 1000 rpm stage promotes solution spreading and uniformity, while the subsequent high-speed 5500 rpm stage induces rapid solvent evaporation, with the precisely timed chlorobenzene (CB) antisolvent drip at 15 seconds before the end triggering instantaneous and dense nucleation. This rapid nucleation event, followed by a controlled thermal annealing at 110°C for 15 minutes, facilitates the coalescence of these nuclei into a compact, pinhole-free film with large, oriented grains, thereby minimizing grain boundary density and suppressing the pathways for non-radiative recombination and ion migration. This optimized morphology and reduced defect density directly facilitate more efficient charge extraction and transport, culminating in the outstanding device parameters: a VOC of 1.1815 V, a JSC of 25.981 mA/cm², an FF of 82.2295%, and a champion PCE of 25.241%.
